text: 兆易创新公告，拟以不低于人民币10亿元且不超过人民币20亿元回购公司A股股份，回购价格不超过750元/股，回购股份将全部用于注销并减少注册资本，回购资金来源为自有资金及/或自筹资金，回购期限自股东会审议通过之日起6个月内。
text_en: GigaDevice announced plans to repurchase its A-share shares for no less than RMB 1 billion and no more than RMB 2 billion, with a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 750 per share. All repurchased shares will be cancelled to reduce registered capital, and the repurchase funds will come from自有 funds and/or self-raised funds, with a repurchase period of 6 months from the date of shareholders' meeting approval.
